Depends on the Swamp Fever raids and on drop luck

During the {wiki:Swamp Fever|Swamp Fever} raids, {creature:Feverish Citizen|Feverish Citizens} roam the streets of Venore and drop six different pieces of cloth: collect all six to unlock the {wiki:Afflicted Outfits|Afflicted Outfits}. The addons (bell and plague doctor mask) come from the {item:Belongings of a Deceased}, which {npc:Ottokar} gives you in exchange for {item:Medicine Pouch|Medicine Pouches} from the {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls}.
You feel close to the victims of the fever outbreak. Your clothes make you one of them, a poor soul among the countless afflicted.
May depend on the world change {wiki:Swamp Fever|Swamp Fever} (Feverish Citizens raids in Venore).
Plague Bell and Plague Mask addons
You don't need to loot anything yourself: you can **buy** the cloth pieces, the Plague Bell and the Plague Mask from other players and just use them.
The items must be in your **inventory** (not in the depot) when you use them.

During the special {wiki:Swamp Fever|Swamp Fever} raids, kill the {creature:Feverish Citizen|Feverish Citizens} roaming the {wiki:Streets of Venore|streets of Venore} and loot the six different cloth pieces:
With all **six** pieces in your inventory, use one of them. You unlock the base outfit.
The pieces must be in your inventory. If they are in the depot, it won't work.

Kill {creature:Swamp Troll|Swamp Trolls} and loot {item:Medicine Pouch|Medicine Pouches}. There are Swamp Trolls in the Venore Swamp Troll Cave, in a small spawn **northwest of Venore**, all over the north of Port Hope and in a cave **southeast of Thais**. To go back, retrace your steps to Venore, where {npc:Ottokar} is.
Swamp Troll cave southeast of Thais
Take the Medicine Pouches to {npc:Ottokar}, in Venore, and trade them for {item:Belongings of a Deceased}.
Open the Belongings of a Deceased
Use the {item:Belongings of a Deceased}: each use has a chance to give a {item:Plague Mask} or a {item:Plague Bell}. Repeat until you have both.
You can also buy the Plague Mask and the Plague Bell from other players.
Use the {item:Plague Bell} to receive the bell addon and the {item:Plague Mask} to receive the mask addon. With both addons you get the achievement **Beak Doctor**.
Plague Bell and Plague Mask addons + Beak Doctor achievement
